data.explain_en: The conjunction “不过” is used at the beginning of the second clause to indicate a turn in meaning. For example:

text.zh: 这个小区的环境真不错，不过我听说，附近有十几家公司，很多刚毕业的学生都租住在这里。

text.py: yuè rì qíng

text.zh: 昨天我顺利租到了合适的房子，今天李文帮我搬家。搬进去的时候，房东又向我介绍了一下房子里的东西，并告诉我这些东西怎么用。
text.py: zuó tiān wǒ shùn lì zū dào le hé shì de fáng zi jīn tiān lǐ wén bāng wǒ bān jiā bān jìn qù de shí hou fáng dōng yòu xiàng wǒ jiè shào le yí xià fáng zi li de dōng xi bìng gào su wǒ zhè xiē dōng xi zěn me yòng

paragraphs.en: Yesterday I managed to rent a suitable apartment, and today Li Wen helped me move. When we moved in, the landlord showed me the things in the apartment again and told me how to use them.

text.zh: 我看了一下，客厅里有椅子、沙发，还有一台大电视；厨房里有冰箱和一些做饭用的东西，不过，我平常主要在学校食堂吃，基本上不做饭。我租的房间里，除了一张床以外，还有一台空调、一张书桌和一把椅子。
text.py: wǒ kàn le yí xià kè tīng li yǒu yǐ zi shā fā hái yǒu yì tái dà diàn shì chú fáng li yǒu bīng xiāng hé yì xiē zuò fàn yòng de dōng xi bú guò wǒ píng cháng zhǔ yào zài xué xiào shí táng chī jī běn shàng bú zuò fàn wǒ zū de fáng jiān li chú le yì zhāng chuáng yǐ wài hái yǒu yì tái kōng tiáo yì zhāng shū zhuō hé yì bǎ yǐ zi

paragraphs.en: I had a look around. The living room has chairs, a sofa and a big TV; the kitchen has a fridge and some cooking things. But I usually eat at the school canteen, so I basically don't cook. In my room, besides a bed, there's an air conditioner, a desk and a chair.

text.zh: 看完整个房子后，我准备再去买几条毛巾，其他东西还不需要。
text.py: kàn wán zhěng gè fáng zi hòu wǒ zhǔn bèi zài qù mǎi jǐ tiáo máo jīn qí tā dōng xi hái bù xū yào

paragraphs.en: After looking around the whole place, I plan to go and buy a few towels. I don't need anything else yet.

data.explain_en: “并” has multiple usages. This lesson introduces its functions as a conjunction and an adverb: (1) as a conjunction, “并” connects parallel disyllabic verbs, phrases, or clauses to indicate a coordinative relationship, implying a further progression; (2) as an adverb, “并” is placed before negative words to strengthen the negative tone, indicating that the fact is not as such. For example:

paragraphs.en: With Li Wen's help, Bai Jiayue rented a suitable apartment. For her, renting this time wasn't easy. Following Li Wen's advice, she first checked listings on rental websites and apps to find suitable places, then went to see the apartments and, at the same time, got to know the surroundings. She looked at quite a few places before finding one where the location, environment and price all suited her, and in the end she rented her ideal apartment.

text.zh: 租房的时候，李文告诉白家月，在中国，由于很多刚工作的年轻人工资还不太高，所以他们一开始也不买房，都选择租房。工作几年后，不少人就会买房，因为大家一直觉得，有房才有家，有自己的房子会更有安全感。

paragraphs.en: While she was looking, Li Wen told her that in China, because many young people who have just started working don't earn much yet, they don't buy a home at first and choose to rent instead. data.explain_en: “由于” has two usages: (1) as a conjunction, used at the beginning of the first clause in a complex sentence to indicate cause, with the second clause generally beginning with words such as “所以” or “因此 (yīncǐ, therefore)”; (2) as a preposition, indicating cause or reason. intro.py: běn kè nǐ xué de zěn me yàng jì zhù le duō shǎo cí huì xiǎo yǔ jiǎng táng lǐ de yǔ yán diǎn nǐ huì yòng le ma guān yú zū fáng zi de huà tí nǐ néng biǎo dá le ma qǐng xiǎng yi xiǎng tián xiě xià bian de biǎo gé

data.intro_en: How much did you learn in this lesson? How many words do you remember? Can you apply the language points from “Xiaoyu's Classroom”? Can you communicate effectively on the topic of renting an apartment? Please reflect on these questions and complete the table below:

text.zh: 能使用本课“房东、出租、房租、收拾、租、入住”等词语，谈论租房话题。
text.py: néng shǐ yòng běn kè fáng dōng chū zū fáng zū shōu shi zū rù zhù děng cí yǔ tán lùn zū fáng huà tí

rows.en: Be able to use key vocabulary from this lesson, such as “房东”, “出租”, “房租”, “收拾”, “租”, and “入住”, to discuss the topic of renting an apartment.

text.zh: 能理解并运用“×就是了”“……，不过……”“并”“由于”等语言点。
text.py: néng lǐ jiě bìng yùn yòng jiù shì le bú guò bìng yóu yú děng yǔ yán diǎn

rows.en: Be able to understand and apply language points such as “×就是了”, “……，不过……”, “并”, and “由于”.

text.zh: 能表达租房还是买房的观点。
text.py: néng biǎo dá zū fáng hái shi mǎi fáng de guān diǎn

rows.en: Be able to express your views on renting or buying an apartment.
